construct: the SAME state-only `border-color` repaint as focus-border-color-state, but the resting plane is `border-width: 0px` over a transparent colour — CSS paints no border at any hue
why: THE ANTI-LOOSENING GUARD. Reading the state's border through the CSS cascade — the override's colour over the resting width — is what lets a keyword-thin focus ring lower; the SAME reading must not manufacture one where the resting width is ZERO. `border-color` with `border-width: 0` is invisible in CSS, and lowering it would let the renderer's 1px default draw a ring the component never has — the HARMFUL class, and the exact failure `hasWidthSource`'s own comment exists to prevent. The cascade widens WHERE the width comes from, never whether it inks.
expectWhere: anatomy.root.states.focus-visible.border-top-color (the CSS half carries the colour faithfully; the refusal this case guards is the CANVAS half)
